findings.title: Shared live report can change after publication
findings.detail: Live sharing and mutable report identity predate this branch. The approved QA change gates readiness and publish mutations; pinning shared copies or adding an egress/edit gate changes the domain workflow. Preserve as a separate existing sharing concern, not an unapproved expansion of CAP-8.

findings.title: Duplicated report does not inherit source methodology findings
findings.detail: Original QA Always explicitly pins findings to report identity and says findings for other reports cannot block the current report; missing compliance is not failure and no AI QA pass is newly required. New report receives its own deterministic findings. Cross-report transfer of methodology authority is outside this accepted contract.

findings.title: Because detector accepts a substring
findings.detail: The existing sentence-level /because/i detector predates the change and is deliberately retained by the frozen QA contract. This specific substring limitation is distinct from the multi-uncertainty case in DW-71; changing the detector requires focused work under its own intent.

findings.title: Scheduled publish PED observes later report/owner
findings.detail: Known DW-49/DW-65 with native product decision pending. Original story explicitly mandates the scheduled reportId-only capture and restricts projects.ts to that scheduled call. Preserve the recorded limitation; do not silently change capture semantics in this integration review.

findings.title: Reviewer submission pins commit-time report
findings.detail: Known DW-44 and deliberate server-side latest-report resolution in approved story7 and domain amendment. A caller-supplied reviewed baseline changes that contract; native decision remains open. No new regression against the chosen implementation.

findings.title: Empty documents consume the document count
findings.detail: The frozen chat matrix counts non-archived documents in trust/insertion order; it does not select the first nonempty documents. It separately prohibits empty rendered blocks and records omitted usable documents. Changing eligibility is a follow-up selection change rather than an implementation failure against this contract.

findings.title: Partially omitted analyzer sources lack an aggregate prompt notice
findings.detail: The analyzer contract requires truncation reporting and later sources dropped/reported; per-source telemetry and cut logs implement it. Aggregate prompt notices for partial omissions were not required, and chat contract explicitly preserves analyzer bytes. Full-omission notices already exist. No current AC violation.

findings.title: Prompt-program analyzer routing disclosure is stale
findings.detail: CAP-10 now deliberately uses fixed MODEL for compare and retains selected single model. Canonical disclosure must describe both. Assigned to bmad-build in Banhall-bmad-analyzer-provenance-fix; no runtime model-policy change or broad DW-7 expansion.

findings.title: Persisted blockers lack a dedicated read surface
findings.detail: The approved QA contract explicitly forbids modifying QA rail/components and retains non-waivable same-content failures despite later scores. A dedicated read surface is a separate UI capability, not missing implementation in the write/gate story.

findings.title: Retired launcher can destroy existing worktrees
findings.detail: Actual integration resurrection at 021f0b4. Removed in reviewed local repair 19b7505738f2477ab646b763f6ae3d659c74d96b, along with unused legacy retry/push wrapper. Integration replay pending active sweep completion.
findings.resolution: 19b7505738f2477ab646b763f6ae3d659c74d96b, retained and source verifier passes at e13e625

findings.title: Retired launcher ignores requested base
findings.detail: Distinct cause, same retired executable. Removal in 19b7505738f2477ab646b763f6ae3d659c74d96b eliminates this entry point; no replacement collector added.

findings.title: Retired launcher collects failed or paused lanes
findings.detail: Removal in 19b7505738f2477ab646b763f6ae3d659c74d96b eliminates this unsafe lifecycle path. Native state/commit/verification evidence remains the completion authority.

findings.title: Production review-decision submission lacks runtime coverage
findings.detail: Confirmed DW-43. Assigned to bmad-build in Banhall-bmad-review-menu-verification to exercise the real menu/dialog and outgoing payload without changing reviewer policy. Native ledger closure waits for independent evidence after integration.

findings.title: Phone redaction removes line breaks
findings.detail: Direct runtime reproduction violates story2 prose-structure invariant. Reviewed repair ae1c59b39beb0a85867c0df539152c01569be65b plus evidence d868ad1d88436d2cfb803c1083d0f1ff8479d94f passes 1744 tests, checks and uploader harnesses; integration pending sweep completion.

coverage_limit: All four layers completed with bounded production/contract tracing, but large tests were selectively reviewed rather than every 17,273 diff line. This is not final shipping approval. New repair/sweep/learning source requires later review and gates.
remaining_scope: Learning4 product choice and queued5–8 remain incomplete; no final19/19 or main promotion.
